title: lepisorus minor
intro: Lepisorus minor, commonly known as the Chinese Rockcap fern, is a species of epiphytic fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including treating fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Lepisorus minor include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Lepisorus minor include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
